ledger.discipline: append-only; nothing edits or deletes a deed; witnessed or not, the deed is written — the witness set decides who learns of it (#272), never whether it counts

entry.subject: refs as the deed needs (individual / item / group)

ledger.home: the Ranger's record, #98 licence family, beside #230's findings

note: RDR2 Honor pulled in 100% per the owner's direction and re-expressed in the programme's derived idiom — deep documentation in RESEARCH-SOURCES.md. Deed values are drafted system data, tunable at landing; the vocabulary and the law are the spec.

pacing.badDeeds: debit without a daily cap — falling is always available

rankEffects.faces: #93 greetings / #242 crowd texture key off visible signs of the band
rankEffects.law: #230/#272 read the ledger as history — mitigation or the opposite, never a pardon
rankEffects.prices: honest shops (#118) discount up the good bands and surcharge the deep bad; fences (#274) mirror it
rankEffects.work: #164 postings band-gated both ways (clean work wants clean names; underworld work wants the opposite)

scale.law: derived at read time from the ledger — a stored morale value anywhere is a landing defect

vsReputation: morale = what you ARE (all deeds, seen or unseen); reputation (#270) = what each group BELIEVES (witnessed facts only). One interaction: first impressions — a group with no witnessed facts reads visible signs of the morale band, provisionally, until its own record exists
